clauses.text: Opinions for LINQ queries against an Entity Framework Core DbContext.
Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring them.
Not for migrations, model configuration, raw SQL, or in-memory LINQ.

baseline: Write Entity Framework Core LINQ queries.

cases.prompt: Write a method that returns the titles of posts with more than 100 views using our EF Core context.
Add a repository method that gets the ten most-viewed posts for a blog id from db.Posts.
I need a report of total views per blog. The data is in our DbContext.

Review this for problems:
```csharp
var posts = db.Posts.ToList().Where(p => p.Views > 100);
```

Refactor this so it stops making one query per blog:
```csharp
foreach (var b in db.Blogs.ToList()) b.Posts = db.Posts.Where(p => p.BlogId == b.Id).ToList();
```
This throws 'could not be translated'. Fix it: db.Posts.Where(p => Slug.IsValid(p.Title))
Add paging to the existing GetPosts method. It queries db.Posts ordered by Views.
Add a migration that adds a Slug column to Blog.
Configure the one-to-many relationship between Blog and Post with the Fluent API, with cascade delete.
Write a Dapper query that returns the top 10 posts by views from SQL Server.
Given a List<Post> already in memory, group by BlogId and sum Views.
This SQL is slow, add the right index: SELECT Title FROM Posts WHERE BlogId = 7 ORDER BY Views DESC
Build a React component that shows a list of posts.
Write a Django ORM query for posts with more than 100 views.
Write xUnit tests for a PriceCalculator class.
